instruction: Could you export the image stored at "/home/user/logo.png" to PDF format with vector layers preserved? This is for documentation purposes.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot preserve vector layers when exporting to PDF, as GIMP is fundamentally a raster graphics editor. While GIMP can export to PDF, it only creates rasterized output, not vector-preserved PDFs. The request to preserve vector layers is impossible with GIMP.
